source: ALLTURN FORKMAN AT-1000S-inspired appearance with the project's existing autonomous stack. Published example specs are reference only. Validated prototype geometry and physical coefficients remain unchanged; this is not an OEM replica or calibration.
physics_geometry_source: Existing EKS215a-derived custom mecanum rig retained for continuity: 2.605m overall length, 0.985m body width, 2.475m fixed mast, 1.2m forks, 2.1m travel; NOT FORKMAN example dimensions.
sensor_geometry_policy: For the FORKMAN appearance, scene captures render the moving/deforming self collision geometry; decorative skins render in the main viewport. Environment and pallet depth remain measured GPU scene data.
stroke_source: Custom 2.1 m carriage travel for two-tier handling, not EKS rated mast reproduction. 2:1 mast stage travels 1.05 m; roof clearance must be verified.
warehouse_source: ScansMatter Warehouse Environment, owned Fab library asset. Local use; original licensed assets excluded from public source uploads.
